outline: 本課程主要目的在於提供方法，用來分析任何型式的結構物受任意動荷重所產生的應力與變化。
schedule:
第1週 : Introduction of Structural Dynamics (1)
第2~4週: Single Degree of Freedom (SDOF) Systems (2~4)
- Formulation of equation of motion
- Free vibration
- Response of harmonic and periodic loading
- Unit impulse response, response to step and pulse excitations
第5~9週: Generalized SDOF Systems (5~9)
- Systems with distributed mass and elasticity
- Lumped mass systems
- Rayleigh’s method for estimating natural frequencies
- Selection of shape functions
第10~16週: Multi-Degree of Freedom (MDOF) Systems (10~16)
- Equations of motion
- Free vibration; natural vibration frequencies and mode shapes
- Modal analysis of linear systems
- Damping in structures
- Response of linear systems to seismic excitation
- Response spectrum analysis
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

教科書: Chopra, “Dynamics of Structures: Theory and Applications to Earthquake Engineering,” Prentice Hall, Inc.
